speaker: Narrator
text: Ash falls like snow. Solhaven's bells ring—not for celebration, but warning.

speaker: Narrator
text: On the horizon, Black Stone Ruins breathe a faint crimson light. The seal is waking.

speaker: Player
text: If the stories are true... the King of Diablo isn't a monster. He's a crown with a will.

speaker: Narrator
text: Day 1 begins. You have 5 rounds today. Every step costs time.

speaker: Airi
text: You. You're heading to the ruins. Don't deny it.

speaker: Player
text: And you are?

speaker: Airi
text: Lady Airi Valen—strategist to the crown. I need someone honest... and disposable.

speaker: Airi
text: If the seal breaks, politics won't matter. Until then, politics is the only shield we have.

speaker: System
text: [Choice] Support the Crown.

speaker: System
text: [Choice] Expose the Truth.

speaker: System
text: [Choice] Stay Silent.

speaker: Airi
text: Good. Then we understand each other. I'll accompany you—officially as an observer.

speaker: System
text: [Party] Lady Airi Valen joined your party.

speaker: Narrator
text: The ruins gate is sealed with cracked runes. Something inside is pushing outward.

speaker: Airi
text: The court wanted this hidden. If people see fear, they will create panic faster than demons.

speaker: Player
text: Then we stop it here.

speaker: Narrator
text: From the rubble, goblin scouts emerge—moving like soldiers, not scavengers.

speaker: Narrator
text: (Battle should trigger here in code: goblin scouts)

speaker: Airi
text: Goblins—organized. They move like they're obeying orders.

speaker: Player
text: Meaning Diablo isn't just waking. He's already ruling.

speaker: Narrator
text: A shadow cuts through the ash. A man stands in the road—alone—holding a halberd too heavy for reality.

speaker: Supreme Fighter
text: You fought well.

speaker: Player
text: Who are you?

speaker: Supreme Fighter
text: A consequence. If Diablo rises, I will end him. If I fall, the world will learn fear with its own hands.

speaker: Airi
text: That weapon... Heavenbreak. The legend is real.

speaker: Supreme Fighter
text: Do not chase legends. Chase tomorrow. Ash makes cowards of kings.

speaker: Narrator
text: The shrine is quiet. The priest has fled. A single candle burns without wind.

speaker: Airi
text: If we survive... promise me something.

speaker: Player
text: What?

speaker: Airi
text: Don't let the kingdom become a tool. Not for demons... and not for heroes.

speaker: Narrator
text: Day 4. The ash thickens. The king's messengers stop returning.

speaker: Narrator
text: Day 8. The Crimson Eclipse begins. Every shadow looks like a doorway.

speaker: Narrator
text: Day 13. The path to Diablo’s realm opens. The air tastes like iron and vows.
